'''''Onteba''''' was a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] responsible for delivering a replacement [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Red Wind]]''. The delivery was a failure as [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] and a set of [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] [[Attack on the Red Wind|destroyed]] the frigate.
